card.name: Digits inside numbers before units
card.fires_on: A digit that is the second or later digit of a number, or the digit after a decimal point, right before a unit such as mg/mL, kg, mcg/kg/min or years. Seen in dose formulas, storage temperatures and age ranges.

modes.label: Formula numbers
modes.description: A digit in a multiplier or divisor inside a dose or volume calculation, before a unit.
modes.example: Volume of 25 mg/mL NULOJIX solution (in mL) = Prescribed Dose (in mg) ÷ 2<<5>> mg/mL 7.
